responsibilities: Acting as project communications lead for one or more EU-funded projects (reporting, consortium meetings, deliverables, keeping track of project expenditures)
Effectively disseminating outputs generated by the federation, its projects and members (e.g, policy papers, reports, press releases, stories) to targeted audiences
Managing REScoop.eu's social media accounts, including content creation, scheduling and engagement analysis
Coordinating with service providers to improve and add features to the Energy Communities Platform and REScoop.eu website
Designing engaging and creative visuals to support messaging using tools such as Adobe Photoshop or Canva
Writing articles for the REScoop.eu website, collecting input from the team, REScoop.eu's projects and partners
Conducting capacity building activities for members, such as workshops or training sessions on communication topics

Regularly updating the REScoop.eu website and the Energy Community Platform by uploading articles, resources, members information, policy papers to the back-end of these websites (Craft CMS and WordPress resp,)
Supporting the Communications Manager in developing and implementing the federation's communications strategy
required_qualifications: You have a minimum of 4 years' experience in communications work
You know how to run an organisation's communications operations
You have strong project management skills
You are familiar with website management systems (craft cms/wordpress) and (social) media monitoring tools
You have a Master's degree in communications/media relations/public relations or a similar subject area
You are an outstanding team player who is ready to work in an international environment
You have a strong will for goal achievement and a high efficiency rate
You can work independently and proactively, handle responsibilities and respect deadlines
You have outstanding communication and English language skills, both written and spoken
Experience working with traditional graphic design tools such as Adobe Photoshop is a plus
You are willing to travel within Europe
You are interested in renewable and sustainable energy. Understanding of the cooperative business model is a plus
You have EU citizenship or have the right to work in the EU

fields.what_we_offer: The opportunity to help us change tomorrow's energy system; A meaningful position in a progressive, international and dynamic working environment; The ability to self-organise work with flexible working conditions; A starting one-year contract in Brussels, Belgium; A full-time position; A competitive remuneration package.
fields.equal_opportunity_statement: REScoop.eu is an open and inclusive, multilingual team and explicitly encourages applications from all applicants, independent of their age, ancestry, colour, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, national origin, political affiliation, race, religion, sex or sexual orientation.
fields.company_overview: REScoop.eu is the European federation of energy communities and represents over 2.500 energy communities and 2 million citizens across Europe. REScoop.eu follows up on relevant policy issues, represents the voice of energy communities towards European policy and decision makers and promotes the cooperative energy business model. We support the start-up of new grassroots initiatives and provide services to our members. While our team represents a variety of different nationalities, our working language is English.
fields.role_overview: As a Senior Communications Officer, you will be integrated into our growing communications team and contribute to the core communication activities of our association. Reporting to the Head of Communications, the Senior Communications Officer plays a central role in strengthening the visibility and reputation of REScoop.eu. The position combines operational and strategic communication tasks, with a high degree of autonomy, expertise and responsibility. The role includes internal communication, member communication and project communication in EU projects.
fields.about_company: REScoop.eu is the European federation of energy communities and represents over 2.500 energy communities and 2 million citizens across Europe.
